body: The Cedar Comets' 2026 season data rests on a thin sample of three games, limiting the reading to only three recorded appearances. Within this cohort, rebounding per game ranks at the 90th percentile (48.0) in an elite band, while assists per game rank at the 75th percentile (23.0) in a strong band. Rebounding is the stronger relative measure in this specific sample. No cross-season comparisons are supported. Fixture availability is unknown.
